record.paper_title: Several Open Problems on Banach Spaces (Castro Urdiales 2014)
record.original_question: In the category of real Banach spaces, is the Kalton-Peck space Z2 even, meaning that Z2 admits a bounded operator J with J^2 = -I_Z2, while no hyperplane of Z2 admits such a complex structure?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Work in the category of real Banach spaces. The Kalton–Peck space $Z_2$ is the twisted Hilbert space defined as
$$Z_2 \;=\; \{(\omega,x)\in\omega(\mathbb{N})\times\ell_2 \;:\; \omega - K(x)\in\ell_2\},$$
where $K\colon c_{00}\to\omega(\mathbb{N})$ is the Kalton–Peck map $K(x)_n = x_n\log(|x_n|/\|x\|_2)$ (with $K(0)=0$), equipped with the quasi-norm $\|(\omega,x)\|_{Z_2}=\|\omega-K(x)\|_2+\|x\|_2$, which is equivalent to a norm making $Z_2$ a real Banach space. A real Banach space $X$ is called even if it admits a bounded linear operator $J\colon X\to X$ with $J^2=-I_X$ (equivalently, $X$ carries a complex Banach space structure compatible with its real structure).

Decide whether the following holds:
(a) $Z_2$ is even, i.e., there exists a bounded linear operator $J\colon Z_2\to Z_2$ with $J^2=-I_{Z_2}$.
(b) No closed hyperplane of $Z_2$ is even; that is, for every closed subspace $H\subset Z_2$ of codimension $1$, there is no bounded linear operator $J\colon H\to H$ with $J^2=-I_H$.
artifact.category_tag: Twisted Hilbert spaces and complex structures
artifact.status_search_result: Partial progress exists. It is known that the natural complex structures on $\ell_2$ do not extend to complex structures on hyperplanes of $Z_2$ containing $\ell_2$, and the complexification description of $Z_2$ has been clarified (the complex Kalton–Peck space equals the complexification of the real one). However, the full conjecture — that $Z_2$ itself is even while no hyperplane of $Z_2$ admits any complex structure — does not appear to have been fully resolved in the literature retrieved.

status_evidence.title: Complex structures on twisted Hilbert spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Investigates complex structures on twisted Hilbert spaces with attention to Kalton-Peck Z2 and the hyperplane problem; shows complex structures on Hilbert space need not extend.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results on (non-)extension of complex structures from ℓ2 to hyperplanes of Z2.

status_evidence.title: The Kalton-Peck space is the complexification of the real Kalton-Peck space
status_evidence.snippet: The complex Kalton–Peck space is the complexification of the real Kalton–Peck space.
status_evidence.claim: This establishes that the real Z2 is even (admits J with J^2=-I).

status_evidence.title: Operators on the Kalton-Peck space Z2
status_evidence.snippet: Studies operators on Z2, including spectral properties and operator ideals.
status_evidence.claim: Related operator-theoretic analysis of Z2 relevant to existence of complex structures.
